newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end lower in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end lower in quiet trading.

text.p: Sept 30 - U.S. debt futures ended down in quiet trading, never recovering from early strong data but unwilling to make a big move ahead of data later this week. Traders looking ahead to Sept NAPM on Tuesday and employment on Friday. Traders noted dealer selling in Dec T-bonds late, with about 4,000 contracts sold by three houses, they said. 109-00 support holds. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
